8.6.4. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.DirObj2EndPaths¶

class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.DirObj2EndPaths(railyard, noSuffix=True, posOrient=None, gType='*', beginFacing=True, positive=None)¶

Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex contains an end object.

Methods

__init__(railyard[, noSuffix, posOrient, …]) Constructor.
endObjectCondition(obj, endInIndex) All objects in the end node are “end objects”.
endObjects(nodeIndex) Iterator over the objects contained in the node of nodeIndex that satisfies the condition specified by endObjectCondition.
generate([gType, beginFacing, positive]) Iterator over the path-tuples of valid paths in railyard that start from a directed object and end in a node whose degree is 1.
getPath() Return a path-tuple.
initPath() Initialize attributes startNodeIndex, endNodeIndex, edgeSequence and visited.
isBentLeg(processedNodeIndex) An utility function that determines if processedNodeIndex connects to a bent leg of a switch.
isEdge(processedNodeIndex, newNodeIndex) A callback function that determines if the edge from processedNodeIndex to newNodeIndex is a valid edge.
isEndNodeIndex() Determine if the endNodeIndex is an end node index when generating the path-tuple for a valid path.
isStartNodeIndex(startNodeIndex) A callback function that determines if startNodeIndex is the start node index for a valid path.
popPath() Pop the last edge from edgeSequence.
pushPath(endNodeIndex) Push the edge ending with endNodeIndex in edgeSequence if it is a valid edge (isEdge returns True).
startObjectCondition(obj, startOutIndex) Determine if an object together with the index of the node containing that object satisfies certain conditions.
startObjects(nodeIndex) Iterator over the objects contained in the node of nodeIndex that satisfies the condition specified by startObjectCondition.
